snippet.title: WORKS: Motorsport Factory - Trailer
snippet.description:
First full trailer for the new motorsport manager tycoon game WORKS: Motorsport Factory coming to Early Access in November. 

A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage — scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive. 



Try the Demo or Wishlist on Steam: 
store.steampowered.com/app/5119400/WORKS_Motorsport_Factory/

Website: worksgame.co.uk

Music and sound: Tao & Sound — Creative Music Solutions
(Building and Crafting Audio Bundle, Buttons SFX Library)


(This is a revised trailer reshot from version 0.63)
